findings.fault: The page gives no way to reach Mark. The first screen has no action, Mark.Moseley@MMMinfra.com appears nowhere, the navigation has no Contact item, and the page doesn't end with an address. The founder also objects: the brief requires one direct, personal way to reach Mark, with the address shown, on the first screen, and getting in touch is the page's one job (brand sheet §1).

findings.where: First screen: the heading 'In my view, we are at a turning point in the story of public-private partnerships.' and the supporting line under it
findings.fault: The heading promises an argument, a turning point, but nothing on the page delivers it. There is no link to the 2020 blog post it comes from and no sentence saying what the turning point is. The supporting line moves on to a list of clients. A reader is left with a claim they can't follow up.
findings.who_objects: A bank or agency officer drawn in by 'turning point' wants to see Mark's reasoning, which is the judgement they would be hiring. Finding no way to read it makes the line look like a slogan rather than his view.
